name: Vehicle passengers leave by their offset exit point on a city floor
contract: The D.R.I.V.E Kart's passenger seats 9996/9997 sit on the kart model's passenger points with a small
negative seat offset, so their server positions lie just below the ground. Their vehicle_seat_addon offset
exit points put Backseat Beauty 110522 and Backseat Babe 110523 about 2.6 yards from the rider. On
Stormwind's WMO floor the line of sight from that underground seat position failed and both were dropped on
the rider's spot. Expected: after dismount both stand at least 1.5 yards from the rider until they leave.
Socketless sessions establish the server-side positions, not the client's animation.
